subject: Aurora Dataworks — capacity uplift / term discussion
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@auroradata.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora capacity + term discussion

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the recent demo — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile, but we're running a parallel evaluation with a vendor called ZephyrAI and a potential internal replatform.

Our renewal is coming up in September and two things are top of mind: 1) a 2x committed throughput increase to support a new feature launch in Q4, and 2) a 12-month term with predictable per-token pricing. Procurement also asked for an updated price deck and evidence of sustained latency at p99 for our 4k token workloads.

Can you send an updated commercial proposal and any benchmark artifacts you can share? We'd also like to schedule a short call next week with R&D and procurement to walk through the proposed measurement plan.

Attachments: none in this message

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of AI Engineering
Aurora Dataworks

We can absolutely support a 2x committed throughput plan and will put together a 12-month commercial term with competitive unit pricing. To be efficient, I attached a short benchmark playbook that shows the scripts and environment we normally ask customers to run (should map cleanly to your cluster). If you prefer, we can run the benchmark from a Redwood-dedicated instance in your VPC to remove any network variance.

- 30-min alignment call (R&D + procurement) — propose Tue 6/15 or Wed 6/16
- We draft a commercial term sheet for a 12-month commit + uplift pricing for 2x capacity
- If you want, we include an assisted PoC window (2 weeks of dedicated bench time) to run the p99 measurement in your environment

I'll follow up with a calendar invite.

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Aurora — strategy before alignment call

Team — quick internal note ahead of the call with Aurora next week. They explicitly called out ZephyrAI and an internal replatform as active threats. Key asks below; thoughts/asks from pricing and pre-sales welcome.

Customer asks we need to cover:
- 2x committed capacity (expected 200k tokens/min sustained w/ spikes to 350k)
- 12-month term; procurement will ask for predictable unit economics and a migration credit
- p99 latency evidence for 4k token sequences
- SOC2 + procurement questionnaire completion

Suggested playbook (what I want to propose):
- Commercial: 12-month commit with tiered unit price — base commit at current unit price, 10% off for the uplift band, 15% off if they prepay 6 months. Include a 1-month migration credit on invoices to mitigate migration costs.
- Technical: Provide a 2-week assisted benchmark in their VPC (we run bench-scripts.tar.gz), capture p50/p95/p99 across peak and steady-state, and commit a remediation run if p99 misses SLA.
- Differentiator: Offer a dedicated onboarding SRE during migration and 3 months of enhanced observability retention to make ops handover low risk.

Pricing ask for Rishi/Dylan: can we get a quick sketch of net unit price for 2x? Also confirm whether we can offer the 1-month credit and the prepay incentive without legal review holdups.

I'll draft the term sheet after we align.

— Jasmine
From: Tom Baines <tbaines@auroradata.com>

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>

Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora — proposed commercial & operational offer (draft)

Hi Elena/Tom — following our internal alignment, please find our proposed offer below. Consider this a formal draft; we'll convert to a short term sheet once you confirm the items.

Commercial (draft):
- Term: 12 months (commencement on effective date)
- Commitment: 2x current committed throughput (detailed in annex)
- Unit pricing: base price per token (current) with uplift band pricing at -10%; prepay 6 months = additional -5% (total -15%)
- Migration credit: one-month invoice credit after successful cutover (applies to committed usage band)

Operational / assurance:
- Assisted bench: 2-week assisted benchmark in Aurora VPC; Redwood provides bench scripts and a dedicated SRE to run/validate results. We will also support an independent third-party run — propose Lighthouse Labs (we've worked with them before) and can share scope-of-work.
- SLAs: p99 latency target and remediation run if missed; 99.95% uptime commitment for dedicated pools during the term
- Security: SOC2 Type II evidence attached; we'll complete the procurement questionnaire within 3 business days and provide a short technical runbook for data segregation during bench runs.

Deliverables / attachments: Aurora_Save_Proposal_v2.pdf (term summary), bench-scripts.tar.gz (scripts for run), benchmark-playbook.pdf, SOC2 evidence link (sent via secure portal).

Next steps: if this looks directionally right, we'll:
1) Confirm the independent-run auditor (we recommend Lighthouse Labs; if Aurora prefers another vendor we're happy to coordinate)
2) Deliver the formal short-form term sheet and updated order form for sign-off (target 7/20 to allow procurement time)
3) Schedule the assisted bench in your VPC for the week of 7/25

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you'd like to tighten numbers before we draft the formal paperwork.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Aurora_Save_Proposal_v2.pdf; bench-scripts.tar.gz
